datasets.name: prev_cleanup_count
queryLines:
WITH all_tables AS (
  SELECT
    table_catalog,
    table_schema,
    table_name,
    CONCAT(table_catalog, '.', table_schema, '.', table_name) AS full_table_name
  FROM
    system.information_schema.tables
  WHERE
    table_schema != 'information_schema'
    AND table_type NOT IN ('VIEW', 'FOREIGN')
    AND table_catalog != 'system'
    AND NOT (
      LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%audit%'
      OR LOWER(table_name) RLIKE '(_log$|_log_|_logs)'
      OR LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%metadata%'
      OR LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%bad_records%'
      OR LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%config%'
    )
),
dup_names AS (
  SELECT
    table_name
  FROM
    all_tables
  GROUP BY
    table_name
  HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT table_catalog) > 1
),
dup_tables AS (
  SELECT
    t.*
  FROM
    all_tables t
      JOIN dup_names d
        ON t.table_name = d.table_name
),
schema_sigs AS (
  SELECT
    table_catalog,
    table_schema,
    table_name,
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(column_name, ':', full_data_type))),
      '|'
    ) AS schema_signature
  FROM
    system.information_schema.columns c
  WHERE
    EXISTS (
      SELECT
        1
      FROM
        dup_names d
      WHERE
        d.table_name = c.table_name
    )
    AND c.table_catalog != 'system'
  GROUP BY
    table_catalog,
    table_schema,
    table_name
),
schema_match AS (
  SELECT
    table_name,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT schema_signature) = 1 THEN 'Yes'
      ELSE 'No'
    END AS schemas_identical
  FROM
    schema_sigs
  GROUP BY
    table_name
),
last_read AS (
  SELECT
    source_table_full_name AS full_table_name,
    MAX(event_time) AS last_read_at
  FROM
    system.access.table_lineage
  WHERE
    source_table_full_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    source_table_full_name
),
last_write AS (
  SELECT
    target_table_full_name AS full_table_name,
    MAX(event_time) AS last_written_at
  FROM
    system.access.table_lineage
  WHERE
    target_table_full_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    target_table_full_name
),
activity AS (
  SELECT
    dt.full_table_name,
    dt.table_name,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(lr.last_read_at, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01'),
      COALESCE(lw.last_written_at, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01')
    ) AS last_used_at
  FROM
    dup_tables dt
      LEFT JOIN last_read lr
        ON dt.full_table_name = lr.full_table_name
      LEFT JOIN last_write lw
        ON dt.full_table_name = lw.full_table_name
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM
  activity a
    JOIN schema_match sm
      ON a.table_name = sm.table_name
WHERE
  a.last_used_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
  AND sm.schemas_identical = 'Yes'

datasets.name: prev_all_dup_detail
queryLines:
WITH all_tables AS (
  SELECT
    table_catalog,
    table_schema,
    table_name,
    table_owner,
    created,
    last_altered,
    CONCAT(table_catalog, '.', table_schema, '.', table_name) AS full_table_name
  FROM
    system.information_schema.tables
  WHERE
    table_schema != 'information_schema'
    AND table_type NOT IN ('VIEW', 'FOREIGN')
    AND table_catalog != 'system'
    AND NOT (
      LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%audit%'
      OR LOWER(table_name) RLIKE '(_log$|_log_|_logs)'
      OR LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%metadata%'
      OR LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%bad_records%'
      OR LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%config%'
    )
),
dup_names AS (
  SELECT
    table_name
  FROM
    all_tables
  GROUP BY
    table_name
  HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT table_catalog) > 1
),
dup_tables AS (
  SELECT
    t.*
  FROM
    all_tables t
      JOIN dup_names d
        ON t.table_name = d.table_name
),
schema_sigs AS (
  SELECT
    table_catalog,
    table_schema,
    table_name,
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(column_name, ':', full_data_type))),
      '|'
    ) AS schema_signature,
    CONCAT(
      '{',
      ARRAY_JOIN(
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT('"', column_name, '": "', full_data_type, '"'))),
        ', '
      ),
      '}'
    ) AS table_schema_def
  FROM
    system.information_schema.columns c
  WHERE
    EXISTS (
      SELECT
        1
      FROM
        dup_names d
      WHERE
        d.table_name = c.table_name
    )
    AND c.table_catalog != 'system'
  GROUP BY
    table_catalog,
    table_schema,
    table_name
),
schema_match AS (
  SELECT
    table_name,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT schema_signature) = 1 THEN 'Yes'
      ELSE 'No'
    END AS schemas_identical
  FROM
    schema_sigs
  GROUP BY
    table_name
),
last_read AS (
  SELECT
    source_table_full_name AS full_table_name,
    MAX(event_time) AS last_read_at
  FROM
    system.access.table_lineage
  WHERE
    source_table_full_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    source_table_full_name
),
last_write AS (
  SELECT
    target_table_full_name AS full_table_name,
    MAX(event_time) AS last_written_at
  FROM
    system.access.table_lineage
  WHERE
    target_table_full_name IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    target_table_full_name
),
schema_presence AS (
  SELECT
    dt.table_name,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN
          LOWER(dt.table_schema) LIKE '%bronze%'
          OR LOWER(dt.table_schema) LIKE '%gold%'
        THEN
          1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS has_bronze_gold
  FROM
    dup_tables dt
      JOIN schema_match sm
        ON dt.table_name = sm.table_name
  WHERE
    sm.schemas_identical = 'Yes'
  GROUP BY
    dt.table_name
)
SELECT
  dt.table_name,
  dt.table_catalog AS catalog,
  dt.table_schema AS schema_name,
  dt.full_table_name,
  dt.table_owner AS owner,
  DATE_FORMAT(dt.created, 'MMM dd, yyyy') AS created_on,
  dt.last_altered,
  lr.last_read_at,
  lw.last_written_at,
  ss.table_schema_def,
  COALESCE(sm.schemas_identical, 'N/A') AS schema_match,
  CASE
    WHEN
      COALESCE(sm.schemas_identical, 'N/A') = 'Yes'
      AND LOWER(dt.table_schema) = 'default'
      AND COALESCE(sp.has_bronze_gold, 0) = 1
    THEN
      'Yes'
    WHEN
      COALESCE(sm.schemas_identical, 'N/A') = 'Yes'
      AND (
        LOWER(dt.table_schema) LIKE '%bronze%'
        OR LOWER(dt.table_schema) = 'default'
      )
      AND (
        COALESCE(lr.last_read_at, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
        OR COALESCE(lw.last_written_at, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01')
          < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
      )
    THEN
      'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS duplicate_table_flag
FROM
  dup_tables dt
    LEFT JOIN schema_match sm
      ON dt.table_name = sm.table_name
    LEFT JOIN schema_sigs ss
      ON dt.table_catalog = ss.table_catalog
      AND dt.table_schema = ss.table_schema
      AND dt.table_name = ss.table_name
    LEFT JOIN last_read lr
      ON dt.full_table_name = lr.full_table_name
    LEFT JOIN last_write lw
      ON dt.full_table_name = lw.full_table_name
    LEFT JOIN schema_presence sp
      ON dt.table_name = sp.table_name
ORDER BY
  dt.table_name,
  dt.table_catalog

columns.expression:
CASE
  WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), DATE(`last_altered`)) = 0 THEN 'today'
  WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), DATE(`last_altered`)) = 1 THEN 'a day ago'
  WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), DATE(`last_altered`)) < 7 THEN CONCAT(STRING(DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), DATE(`last_altered`))), ' days ago')
  WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), DATE(`last_altered`)) < 14 THEN 'a week ago'
  WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), DATE(`last_altered`)) < 30 THEN CONCAT(STRING(FLOOR(DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), DATE(`last_altered`)) / 7)), ' weeks ago')
  WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), DATE(`last_altered`)) < 60 THEN 'a month ago'
  WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), DATE(`last_altered`)) < 365 THEN CONCAT(STRING(FLOOR(DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), DATE(`last_altered`)) / 30)), ' months ago')
  WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), DATE(`last_altered`)) < 730 THEN 'a year ago'
  ELSE CONCAT(STRING(FLOOR(DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), DATE(`last_altered`)) / 365)), ' years ago')
END

columns.description: Explains why a table was flagged as duplicate based on schema match, layer, and staleness rules
columns.expression:
CASE
  WHEN `duplicate_table_flag` = 'No' THEN 'Not flagged as duplicate'
  WHEN `duplicate_table_flag` = 'Yes' AND LOWER(`schema_name`) = 'default' AND (DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), COALESCE(DATE(`last_read_at`), DATE('1970-01-01'))) > 30 OR DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), COALESCE(DATE(`last_written_at`), DATE('1970-01-01'))) > 30) THEN 'Schema matched + default schema with bronze/gold counterpart + stale (30+ days)'
  WHEN `duplicate_table_flag` = 'Yes' AND LOWER(`schema_name`) = 'default' THEN 'Schema matched + default schema table also exists in bronze/gold layer'
  WHEN `duplicate_table_flag` = 'Yes' AND LOWER(`schema_name`) LIKE '%bronze%' THEN 'Schema matched + bronze layer table is stale (30+ days)'
  ELSE 'Flagged — rule details unavailable'
END

  WHERE

    AND NOT (

      OR LOWER(table_name) RLIKE '(_log$|_log_|_logs)'
      OR LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%metadata%'
      OR LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%bad_records%'
      OR LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%config%'
    )
),
schema_sigs AS (
  SELECT
    c.table_catalog,
    c.table_schema,
    c.table_name,
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(c.column_name, ':', c.full_data_type))),
      '|'
    ) AS schema_signature,
    CONCAT(
      '{',
      ARRAY_JOIN(
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT('"', c.column_name, '": "', c.full_data_type, '"'))),
        ', '
      ),
      '}'
    ) AS table_schema_def
  FROM
    system.information_schema.columns c
  WHERE
    c.table_schema != 'information_schema'
    AND c.table_catalog != 'system'
    AND NOT (
      LOWER(c.table_name) LIKE '%audit%'
      OR LOWER(c.table_name) RLIKE '(_log$|_log_|_logs)'
      OR LOWER(c.table_name) LIKE '%metadata%'
      OR LOWER(c.table_name) LIKE '%bad_records%'
      OR LOWER(c.table_name) LIKE '%config%'
    )
  GROUP BY
    c.table_catalog,
    c.table_schema,
    c.table_name
),
matching_schemas AS (
  SELECT
    schema_signature,
    COUNT(DISTINCT table_catalog) AS catalog_match_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_match_instances
  FROM
    schema_sigs
  GROUP BY
    schema_signature
  HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT table_catalog) > 1
),
matched_tables AS (
  SELECT
    ss.*
  FROM
    schema_sigs ss
      JOIN matching_schemas ms
        ON ss.schema_signature = ms.schema_signature
),
last_read AS (
  SELECT
    source_table_full_name AS full_table_name,
    MAX(event_time) AS last_read_at
  FROM
    system.access.table_lineage
  WHERE
    source_table_full_name IS NOT NULL
    AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
  GROUP BY
    source_table_full_name
),
last_write AS (
  SELECT
    target_table_full_name AS full_table_name,
    MAX(event_time) AS last_written_at
  FROM
    system.access.table_lineage
  WHERE
    target_table_full_name IS NOT NULL
    AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
  GROUP BY
    target_table_full_name

SELECT
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mt.schema_signature) AS schema_group_id,
  mt.table_name,
  at.table_catalog AS catalog,
  at.catalog_schema,
  at.table_owner AS owner,
  DATE_FORMAT(at.created, 'MMM dd, yyyy') AS created_on,
  at.last_altered,
  lr.last_read_at,
  lw.last_written_at,
  mt.table_schema_def,
  ms.catalog_match_count,
  ms.total_match_instances
FROM
  matched_tables mt
    JOIN matching_schemas ms
      ON mt.schema_signature = ms.schema_signature
    JOIN all_tables at
      ON mt.table_catalog = at.table_catalog
      AND mt.table_schema = at.table_schema
      AND mt.table_name = at.table_name
    LEFT JOIN last_read lr
      ON at.full_table_name = lr.full_table_name
    LEFT JOIN last_write lw
      ON at.full_table_name = lw.full_table_name
ORDER BY
  schema_group_id,
  at.catalog_schema

      OR LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%metadata%'
      OR LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%bad_records%'
      OR LOWER(table_name) LIKE '%config%'
    )
),
dup_names AS (
  SELECT
    table_name
  FROM
    all_tables
  GROUP BY
    table_name
  HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT table_catalog) > 1
),
schema_sigs AS (
  SELECT
    table_catalog,
    table_schema,
    table_name,
    ARRAY_JOIN(
      SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CONCAT(column_name, ':', full_data_type))),
      '|'
    ) AS schema_signature
  FROM
    system.information_schema.columns c
  WHERE
    EXISTS (
      SELECT
        1
      FROM
        dup_names d
      WHERE
        d.table_name = c.table_name
    )
    AND c.table_catalog != 'system'
  GROUP BY
    table_catalog,
    table_schema,
    table_name
),
schema_match AS (
  SELECT
    table_name,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT schema_signature) = 1 THEN 'Yes'
      ELSE 'No'
    END AS schemas_identical
  FROM
    schema_sigs
  GROUP BY
    table_name
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(sm.schemas_identical, 'N/A') AS schema_status,
  COUNT(*) AS table_count
FROM
  dup_names d
    LEFT JOIN schema_match sm
      ON d.table_name = sm.table_name
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(sm.schemas_identical, 'N/A')

WITH suffixed_tables AS (
  SELECT
    t.table_catalog,
    t.table_schema,
    t.table_name,
    t.table_owner,
    t.created,
    t.last_altered,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(
      LOWER(t.table_name),
      '_(bkp|bckp|test|empty|version1|v1|v2|1|2)$',
      ''
    ) AS base_name,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(t.table_name) RLIKE '_bkp$' THEN '_bkp'
      WHEN LOWER(t.table_name) RLIKE '_bckp$' THEN '_bckp'
      WHEN LOWER(t.table_name) RLIKE '_test$' THEN '_test'
      WHEN LOWER(t.table_name) RLIKE '_empty$' THEN '_empty'
      WHEN LOWER(t.table_name) RLIKE '_version1$' THEN '_version1'
      WHEN LOWER(t.table_name) RLIKE '_v1$' THEN '_v1'
      WHEN LOWER(t.table_name) RLIKE '_v2$' THEN '_v2'
      WHEN LOWER(t.table_name) RLIKE '_1$' THEN '_1'
      WHEN LOWER(t.table_name) RLIKE '_2$' THEN '_2'
    END AS suffix_type,
    CONCAT(t.table_catalog, '.', t.table_schema, '.', t.table_name) AS full_table_name
  FROM
    system.information_schema.tables t
  WHERE
    t.table_schema != 'information_schema'
    AND t.table_type NOT IN ('VIEW', 'FOREIGN')
    AND t.table_catalog != 'system'
    AND LOWER(t.table_name) RLIKE '_(bkp|bckp|test|empty|version1|v1|v2|1|2)$'
),
all_tables AS (
  SELECT
    table_catalog,
    table_schema,
    LOWER(table_name) AS table_name
  FROM
    system.information_schema.tables
  WHERE
    table_schema != 'information_schema'
    AND table_type NOT IN ('VIEW', 'FOREIGN')
    AND table_catalog != 'system'
)
SELECT
  s.table_name,
  s.table_catalog AS anomaly_catalog,
  s.table_schema AS schema_name,
  s.base_name AS original_table,
  s.suffix_type,
  s.full_table_name,
  s.table_owner AS owner,
  DATE_FORMAT(s.created, 'MMM dd, yyyy') AS created_on,
  s.last_altered
FROM
  suffixed_tables s
    JOIN all_tables a
      ON s.table_catalog = a.table_catalog
      AND s.table_schema = a.table_schema
      AND s.base_name = a.table_name
ORDER BY
  s.table_catalog,
  s.table_schema,
  s.base_name
